saa_oh_2024.text: Interviewees must be given a formal window to review and request redaction from their transcript before it enters the archive.
The Dublin Core metadata schema is the required standard for NEH-funded oral history collections — all 15 fields must be present at intake, no exceptions.
No oral history recording should be ingested into a permanent archive without sign-off from a community advisory board or a designated community liaison.
Access tiers must include at minimum three levels — open, restricted, and closed or embargoed. The closed tier is controlled solely by the interviewee or their family.
An oral history rights statement is not interchangeable with a Creative Commons license. They serve fundamentally different legal and ethical purposes and both may be required.
